description: This file contains unit tests for the LocationHandler class in an Android app. It includes test cases for permission checks, location retrieval behavior, fallback logic, timeout handling, and error cases. It also defines a FakeLocationDataSource class to simulate different permission and location scenarios during testing.

classes.name: LocationHandlerTest
classes.description: A test class for LocationHandler, implementing various test cases for location permission handling, provider fallback, and error conditions.

classes.name: FakeLocationDataSource
classes.description: A mock implementation of LocationDataSource for testing, simulating permission grants, location payload responses, failures, and timeouts.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_requiresLocationPermissionWhenNeitherFineNorCoarse
methods.description: Tests that the handler requires location permission when neither fine nor coarse permissions are granted.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_requiresForegroundBeforeLocationPermission
methods.description: Tests that foreground permission is required before location permission is granted.

methods.name: hasFineLocationPermission_reflectsDataSource
methods.description: Verifies that the handler correctly reports fine location permission based on data source.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_usesPreciseGpsFirstWhenFinePermissionAndPreciseEnabled
methods.description: Tests that precise GPS is used first when fine permission is available and precise mode is enabled.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_fallsBackToBalancedWhenPreciseUnavailable
methods.description: Checks fallback to balanced providers when precise mode is unavailable.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_mapsTimeoutToLocationTimeout
methods.description: Verifies that timeout scenarios are correctly mapped to a location timeout error.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_mapsOtherFailuresToLocationUnavailable
methods.description: Ensures other failures are mapped to location unavailable errors.
